tierReason: graphs/pipeline-5-roads.json joins district centres into a road network with the lune-test connection mode, and graphs/basics-gabriel-cells.json shows the same connection modes side by side; both ship inside the installed package, so the network half of this task has a near-solution an agent can find.
title: Settlements joined by a planar, connected road network

checks.description: 30-50 settlement points, all inside the 400 m square centred on the origin (+-0.01 m), level at height 0 (+-0.5 m), and no two closer than 25 m (-0.01 m of float slack), spacing measured on the ground plane (X and Z; height ignored).
The roads output holds at least one polyline, and every polyline is exactly 2 points whose two ends each lie within 0.5 m (on the ground plane) of a settlement, and not the same settlement.

Measured on the ground plane (X and Z; height ignored): no two straight pieces of road intersect anywhere except at a settlement they share (road vertices within 0.5 m of a settlement are snapped onto it first); T-junctions, overlaps and the same road laid twice count as intersections, and the result separates duplicates from crossings.
Taking each road as a link between the settlements its two ends lie on, the settlements form exactly one connected group.
Every settlement has at least one road ending at it. Soft: for 2 or more settlements it is implied by connected, so no negative can fail it without failing connected too.
